resolution: First refresh of a frozen 2026-07-17 pre-lane article, taken through the full audit lane per the D4 companion ruling. Structural rewrite approved by James 2026-08-27: the May article claimed a "complete list" while showing 23 of the by-then-212 bills (written 2026-05-08 when the database held 23; the June-August backlog batches grew it behind the page). New form: audited narrative + a complete 212-bill roster generated from data/cache.json by scripts/generate-tracker-roster.js, receipts bound to the committed corpus snapshot. Unsourced inherited claims removed rather than kept: "first Section 702 lapse since 2008" (no stored source) and "collection under certifications continues until they expire" (replaced with the statute-bound up-to-1-year authorization span).
notes: Snapshot source (record-lp-corpus-119-snapshot.txt) is regenerated ONLY by a tracker refresh, never by batch runs — receipts stay stable between refreshes; generate-tracker-roster.js --check is deliberately NOT a pre-commit gate (same live-fixture reason as tracker:gate:test).
HR-9770 cache votes carry both a 2026-07-20 voice-vote row and the 2026-07-21 Roll 272 row for "On Passage"; article binds to Roll 272.

Roster apostrophe encoding mirrors cache title data faithfully: titles stored with curly apostrophes render them literally, titles stored with straight apostrophes render as ' via escHtml. Cosmetic inconsistency inherited from the corpus, noted by audit pass 1.
HR-4366 carries stage "committee" with site-wide stageLabel "On House Calendar" — the roster heading mirrors the label, as every site surface does (taxonomy naming quirk, noted by audit pass 1).

Audit pass 1 (Sonnet, hostile full-claims): 0 errors / 4 warn / 5 note. All 4 warnings were ledger-coverage or span-precision fixes (rows intro.analyzed, meta.count, meta.signed, signed.s1071.substance added; HR-7148 spans tightened); no prose changes required.

Audit pass 2 (Sonnet, fresh independent full re-derivation): CLEAN — 0 errors / 0 warn / 2 cosmetic notes (a ledger note-field wording fix applied; unescaped & in the Google Fonts URL is site-wide boilerplate, unchanged). Roster re-verified programmatically: 212/212 items, counts, order, hrefs, titles all match snapshot + slug-index.

DELTA REFRESH 2026-08-27 (same day, corpus 212 -> 219 after the two demand batches): roster + snapshot regenerated; generator now emits one section per stageLabel within stage order (resolves the mixed-label fail-close the committee group triggered); count claims updated (219 total / 16 senate incl. S-2296 / 122 house incl. HR-139 / 5 In Committee + 1 On House Calendar); no other prose changed. Delta verified by a focused cross-model pass over the changed claims.
